name: Nava Limited
summary: Nava Limited, established in 1972 and headquartered in Hyderabad, is a diversified enterprise in power generation, mining, ferro alloys and healthcare, with reach into Zambia, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore and other markets. Its power division generates electricity from coal, biomass, biogas and bagasse, with plants in Telangana, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh and a larger facility overseas.
